newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Decision on Swebus sale to Stagecoach next week.
newsitem.headline: Decision on Swebus sale to Stagecoach next week.

text.p: Swedish state railways company Statens Jarnvagar said on Friday it would announce early next week if it would allow Britain's Stagecoach Holdings Plc to buy its longhaul bus operator Swebus.
"It will be announced in the beginning of next week," SJ spokesman Bjorn Hallden told Reuters.

Stagecoach said in July it would sign a letter of intent with SJ subsidiary Swedcarrier to buy Swebus, the Nordic region's largest bus company with around 3,500 buses in operation in Sweden, Finland, Norway and Denmark.
Analysts have said Swebus should have a price tag of between 110 and 120 million pounds ($170 to $190 million). ($1=.6420 Pound)
